name: REPO Improvement Landing
description: How to land a REPO-level (upstream) platform improvement: confirm it is clean of operator identity, run the contamination scan, branch, and open a PR to main.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When landing a REPO-tier improvement (a generic change to corekit/, brain/, skills/, app/, or generic infra/) that should flow upstream. Defines the contamination gate and PR procedure. Never use for operator-specific changes.
